purpose: Evaluator reference for revision validity; never include in revision-task input capsules.

FAMILY01.selector: Reflective silver film at measured reflectance 0.72, toward-sun bearing 21 degrees off nadir, stable high D, valid M0 QC.
FAMILY01.action: A source-bounded reflection-control discriminator uses the same marked canopy at an away-sun 8-degree off-nadir view with paired scans and contact-leaf reference immediately after each; do not rely on D alone before resolving the discriminator; preserve M0 soil-moisture confirmation regardless.
FAMILY01.fallback: Unstable coverage/view or incomplete control data requires stable reacquisition; never infer stress or irrigation.
critical_errors: claims stress or irrigation from D

FAMILY02.selector: QC-passing reproducible composition matching one of the exact E1 floc-rich tuples (21%,46%), (18%,49%), or (24%,42%) mineral/organic percentages, with turbidity in 100–300 NTU.
FAMILY02.action: Use the E1 floc-rich empirical relation 91/171/251 mg/L at 100/200/300 NTU and interpolate only within the observed turbidity range; preserve M0 mineral-dominant formula for its measured regime.
FAMILY02.fallback: Outside exact observed composition tuples, outside the turbidity span, or with unresolved composition/QC, reconcile composition or obtain gravimetry; no floc-rich point estimate.
critical_errors: attaches M0 ±12 mg/L to E1 estimate

FAMILY03.selector: Verified group P plus a complete aligned high-rate pulse within the observed group-P envelope: 9–13 minutes and peaks 13.7–14.4 degrees C; M0 interval means may remain below 8.0 degrees C.
FAMILY03.action: Retain the M0 mean-only pass as baseline and add STABILITY_REVIEW for the observed group-P pulse context only; group-S matched pulsed control does not license a universal pulse rule.
FAMILY03.fallback: Incomplete or custody-gapped high-rate trace requires RECONCILE_LOGGER and UNSCORABLE if unresolved; complete group-P no-pulse profile preserves M0 pass.
critical_errors: generalizes group-P relation to other formulations
